As a result of his actions during Fiesta de Santa Fe, Justin attended a probation violation hearing, where he denied violating his probation. Currently, Justin awaits a pretrial conference scheduled for July 3, 2025. As a result of the four separate instances of officers shooting at Justin during the pursuit, eight Santa Fe police officers and one Santa Fe County Sheriff's Deputy Chief were placed on administrative leave per departmental policy. According to local reporting, the Santa Fe County Sheriff's Deputy Chief and three city police officers were cleared to return to active duty in early February. However, their actions are still under investigation by New Mexico State Police. They will present their findings to the first Judicial District Attorney's Office, who will decide whether the shootings were justified. No additional information was readily available for the other five city officers who were placed on leave. Justin Jimenez is innocent, unless proven guilty in a court of law.
